map.箱板纸与瓦楞纸质控：由耐破度除以定量得到耐破指数，跨克重比较顶破强度，判断原料强: For linerboard and corrugated quality control: divide the burst strength by the grammage to get the burst index, compare the puncture strength across grammages, and judge whether the raw material strength meets the standard.

map.耐破指数 = 350 ÷ 80 = 4.375 kPa·m²/g；换算 350: Burst index = 350 ÷ 80 = 4.375 kPa·m²/g; converted 350 × 0.0102 = 3.57 kgf/cm²; deviation against the common reference 3.0 kPa·m²/g = (4.375 − 3.0) ÷ 3.0 × 100% = 45.83%.

1 kPa ≈ 0.0102 kgf/cm² (that is, 1 kgf/cm² ≈ 98.07 kPa). Chinese paper mills conventionally use kgf/cm² while export orders often use kPa; this tool gives both conventions.
